description: Web steward worker: upkeep for site dependencies and design skills. Use when a web repo needs dependencies upgraded or audited, when an install or build warns about unmet peers, before a new front-end dependency lands, or on a scheduled upkeep run: runs the web-steward peer check against the lockfile and registry, triages drift, prepares one upgrade branch per repo with gates and before/after proof, and stops at a draft PR. Never merges.
